content:
# Display Style

The `style.display` property changes whether a selected element is shown on the page. Use it to hide an element with `"none"` or show it again with a display value like `"block"`.
name: Display Style
tips:
- Use `style.display` on an element that has already been selected.
- Use `"none"` to hide an element.
- Use `"block"` to show an element as a block on the page.
- Put display values in quotation marks.
- In Web Lab, `style.display` often appears inside event handlers for buttons that reveal answers, menus, messages, or sections.
